narr: Ample monoon moisture and slow moving thunderstorms brought lightning, heavy rain, and flash flooding to a few locations across northern Arizona.
ev: Heavy rain fell over the Pipeline Fire scar in Weatherford Canyon. This sent a flash flood about 1.5 feet deep down Government Tank Wash. The water covered Waterline Road and Switchback Trail. The water then flowed into the first retention basin just west of Landfill Road.
The stream gauge on Chevelon Creek showed a rapid rise of around 4 feet between noon and 200 PM MST. The creek return to near normal levels at around 100 AM MST on August 13.
